_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in Qatari riyals. The debt component, history and facts are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_qatar.py from the Ministry of Finance's Public Debt dataset; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Qatar
publisher: Ministry of Finance of Qatar (open-data portal, data.gov.qa)
title: Qatar Debt Clock: Live Total Public Debt, Official Data
headline: total public debt
subject: The State of Qatar
sum_note: Qatar's total public debt (domestic and external), year-end, from the Ministry of Finance's Public Debt dataset on the national open-data portal. Annual figures only.
scope_note: This is the "Total Public Debt" that Qatar's Ministry of Finance publishes in its Public Debt dataset on the national open-data portal (data.gov.qa): domestic debt plus external debt at the end of each calendar year, in Qatari riyals. It is the Ministry's own figure and is gross; it is not reduced by the government's financial assets, which are large. Qatar publishes this series once a year, so the figure on this page can be many months old and the live number is a projection of the year-on-year trend.
trend_why: We use the change over the last full year, because Qatar publishes only year-end positions.
legend: Qatar's public debt is reported once a year, at year-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
cadence: Annual. The Ministry of Finance adds each year-end position to the open-data portal some months after the year closes.
next_update: The Ministry of Finance adds each year-end position to its open-data portal after the year closes; the 2026 figure is expected during 2027. This page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: Planning and Statistics Authority (PSA), Population estimates by gender and age group, 2024, total of all age groups (data.gov.qa)
population.method_short: PSA 2024 population estimate (the latest year on the open-data portal), all ages

components.label: Qatar total public debt
components.source_name: Ministry of Finance of Qatar, Public Debt dataset (data.gov.qa), Total Public Debt, QAR million
components.source_locator: Dataset public-debt, record item "Total Public Debt" (also Domestic Debt and External Debt), by year; machine-readable through the portal's open API
components.includes: The state's total public debt: domestic and external, in riyals, gross. The dataset does not break out the debt of state-owned entities and none is added here; the assets of the sovereign wealth fund are not netted off.

extra_sources.name: Planning and Statistics Authority of Qatar

notes: Why the Ministry's dataset: it is the Ministry of Finance's own published series on the government's open-data portal (open licence), with the domestic and external parts. The fetcher checks that the two parts add up to the total.
Annual only: Qatar does not publish a more frequent official debt series that we could find, so the figure is a year-end position and the live number between years is a projection, labelled as such.
Gross: Qatar holds very large financial assets, mostly in the Qatar Investment Authority; none of that is subtracted here.
Currency: Qatari riyals. The riyal is pegged to the US dollar at 3.64 riyals per dollar, which the World Debt Clock uses for conversion.
